---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — PH results"
subtitle: "Adjusted (fixed): Hazard ratio and standardized survival curves"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The proportional-hazards analysis reports the treatment hazard ratio and
standardized survival curves over unrestricted follow-up. No RMST is
calculated. Survival bands combine 1,000 posterior draws from each of the five
imputations with equal weight.

```{r}
#| label: derive-supporting-os-unrestricted-ph-results
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
n_draws <- 1000L
imputations <- readRDS(here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted", "imputations.rds"
))
model_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-ph", "models"
)
curve_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-ph", "survival-curves"
)
result_dir <- here::here(
  "results", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-ph"
)
figure_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-ph", "figures"
)
dir.create(curve_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

observed <- mice::complete(imputations, 1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tx_plot = factor(tx, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Control", "Intervention"))
  )
max_follow_up <- max(observed$survival_time_days_unrestricted, na.rm = TRUE)

hr_draws <- vector("list", length(indices))
for (index in indices) {
  curve_path <- file.path(
    curve_dir,
    sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  hr_path <- file.path(curve_dir, sprintf("hazard-ratio-%02d.parquet", index))
  outputs_complete <- FALSE
  if (all(file.exists(c(curve_path, hr_path)))) {
    saved_curves <- arrow::read_parquet(
      curve_path,
      col_select = c("draw", "tx")
    )
    outputs_complete <- dplyr::n_distinct(saved_curves$draw) == n_draws &&
      setequal(saved_curves$tx, 0:1) &&
      nrow(arrow::read_parquet(hr_path)) == n_draws
  }
  if (!force && outputs_complete) next

  model <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))
  standardization_data <- mice::complete(imputations, index) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2))
  prediction_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 800L)

  curve_list <- vector("list", 2L)
  for (treatment in 0:1) {
    newdata <- standardization_data |>
      dplyr::mutate(tx = treatment)
    raw_curves <- rstanarm::posterior_survfit(
      model,
      newdata = newdata,
      times = 0,
      extrapolate = TRUE,
      standardise = TRUE,
      control = list(edist = max_follow_up, epoints = 200L),
      return_matrix = TRUE,
      draws = n_draws,
      seed = prediction_seed
    )
    curve_matrix <- if (is.matrix(raw_curves)) {
      raw_curves
    } else {
      do.call(cbind, raw_curves)
    }
    curve_matrix <- as.matrix(curve_matrix)
    times <- if (is.list(raw_curves)) {
      purrr::map_dbl(raw_curves, ~ as.numeric(attr(.x, "times")))
    } else {
      attr(raw_curves, "times")
    }
    if (is.null(times)) {
      times <- seq(0, max_follow_up, length.out = ncol(curve_matrix))
    }
    if (nrow(curve_matrix) < n_draws && ncol(curve_matrix) == n_draws) {
      curve_matrix <- t(curve_matrix)
    }
    if (length(times) != ncol(curve_matrix)) {
      stop("Survival-curve time points do not match the posterior matrix.")
    }
    curve_list[[treatment + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
      draw = rep(seq_len(n_draws), each = length(times)),
      time = rep(times, times = n_draws),
      survival = as.vector(t(curve_matrix[seq_len(n_draws), , drop = FALSE])),
      tx = treatment,
      imputation = index
    )
  }

  coefficient_draws <- as.matrix(model, pars = "tx")
  set.seed(analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 850L))
  selected_draws <- sample(seq_len(nrow(coefficient_draws)), n_draws)
  hr <- tibble::tibble(
    imputation = index,
    draw = seq_len(n_draws),
    log_hazard_ratio = coefficient_draws[selected_draws, 1],
    hazard_ratio = exp(log_hazard_ratio)
  )

  arrow::write_parquet(
    dplyr::bind_rows(curve_list),
    curve_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  arrow::write_parquet(hr, hr_path, compression = "zstd")
}

pooled_curves <- indices |>
  purrr::map(~ arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    curve_dir,
    sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", .x)
  ))) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()
pooled_hr <- indices |>
  purrr::map(~ arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    curve_dir,
    sprintf("hazard-ratio-%02d.parquet", .x)
  ))) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

curve_summary <- pooled_curves |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(tx, time)
  )
hr_summary <- pooled_hr |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median = median(hazard_ratio),
    ci_66_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(hazard_ratio < 1),
    imputations = dplyr::n_distinct(imputation),
    draws_per_imputation = n_draws
  )

arrow::write_parquet(
  curve_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "survival-curve-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  pooled_hr,
  file.path(result_dir, "hazard-ratio-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  hr_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "hazard-ratio-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-supporting-os-unrestricted-ph-plots
#| include: false

curve_summary <- curve_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tx_plot = factor(tx, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Control", "Intervention"))
  )
km_fit <- ggsurvfit::survfit2(
  survival::Surv(
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    status_death_unrestricted
  ) ~ tx_plot,
  data = observed,
  conf.type = "log-log"
)
risk_times <- seq(0, max_follow_up, by = 100)

survival_plot <- ggsurvfit::ggsurvfit(
  km_fit,
  linewidth = 0.55,
  linetype = 2
) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    data = curve_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = tx_plot),
    alpha = 0.16,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = curve_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(x = time, y = median, colour = tx_plot),
    linewidth = 0.9,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggsurvfit::add_censor_mark(size = 1.8) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = risk_times) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max_follow_up), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Days since randomization",
    y = "Survival probability",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggsurvfit::add_risktable(
    times = risk_times,
    risktable_stats = c("n.risk", "cum.event"),
    stats_label = list(n.risk = "At risk", cum.event = "Events")
  )

hr_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(pooled_hr, ggplot2::aes(x = hazard_ratio)) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(side = "bottom") +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    .width = c(0.66, 0.95),
    point_interval = ggdist::median_qi
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Hazard ratio, intervention versus control", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "kaplan-meier-vs-ph-model.png"),
  ggsurvfit::ggsurvfit_build(survival_plot),
  width = 8,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 300
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "hazard-ratio-posterior.png"),
  hr_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
